input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use the provided Riven's Broken Sword reference for the weapon.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the current environment.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
only for the dark figure.

Maintain the same burning settlement atmosphere:
wooden buildings on fire,
heavy dark smoke,
orange firelight,
ash drifting through the air,
and the long village road running between the buildings.

Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of her Broken Sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The remaining sword is large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured edge with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Burning mountain settlement at nightfall.

Heavy drifting smoke.

Strong orange firelight.

Natural fire, wind, ash, footsteps,
burning wood, and distant structural sounds.

Restrained realistic acting.

Slow controlled cinematic tension.

Natural body movement.

Natural English voice and lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat in this scene.

Keep the geography simple and visually readable.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== IMPORTANT STORY RULE ===

The mysterious figure appears farther down
the main road inside the burning settlement.

Riven and the figure remain separated
by a clear physical distance.

The figure does NOT rush toward Riven.

The figure does NOT attack.

Riven does NOT attack.

This is a tense face-to-face confrontation,
not a fight.

Unlike before,
the mysterious figure does NOT disappear.

It remains present through the end of the scene.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven stands inside the burning settlement,
looking down the long road ahead.

She hears a faint unnatural sound.

Through the smoke farther down the road,
the same mysterious dark figure slowly appears.

This time it is closer and more visible.

It does not disappear.

Riven recognizes it.

Quietly, almost to herself, she says:

"You..."

The figure subtly reacts,
as if it recognizes Riven too.

Riven slowly draws her Broken Sword
and raises the broken weapon defensively.

Before either side attacks,
an elderly man's desperate cry for help
comes from a nearby burning building.

Riven looks toward the voice.

An elderly civilian is trapped inside
and cannot escape by himself.

Riven looks back toward the mysterious figure.

It is still there.

CUT before Riven makes her choice.


=== SHOT 1 — THE ROAD ===

OPEN on a new medium three-quarter view of Riven.

Do not recreate the exact previous camera composition.

Riven is already standing inside
the burning settlement.

She is no longer walking.

Orange firelight flickers naturally
across her face and clothing.

Burning wooden buildings surround the road.

Heavy smoke drifts between the structures.

Ash floats through the orange light.

Riven remains silent.

She looks toward the long road
leading deeper into the settlement.


Then—

a faint unnatural sound comes
from somewhere farther ahead.

Riven immediately becomes alert.

She stops completely.

Her eyes focus on the road.


CUT to an over-the-shoulder view behind Riven.

Use the long central village road
as the main visual axis.

Riven occupies the near foreground.

The road extends deep into the settlement
between burning buildings.

At first there is nothing ahead.

Only fire.

Smoke.

Ash.

An empty road.


Then—

smoke farther down the road
slowly begins to shift.

Through the smoke,

a DARK HUMAN-LIKE SILHOUETTE
gradually becomes visible.


It is the same mysterious dark figure.

Keep it at a clear distance from Riven.

It stands farther down the road.

Do not place it close to her.


The figure is almost humanoid,
but subtly unnatural.

Its shoulders appear slightly too high.

Its arms appear slightly too long.

Its silhouette is difficult to read.

Its edges seem to blend unnaturally
into the surrounding smoke.

Nearby orange firelight does not illuminate it normally.

Its face remains hidden.

No glowing eyes.

No clear facial features.

No detailed monster anatomy.


Smoke continues moving around the figure.

But the figure remains standing there.

THIS TIME IT DOES NOT DISAPPEAR.


Riven remains completely still.

She recognizes it.


=== SHOT 2 — FACE TO FACE ===

Move into a restrained medium close-up of Riven.

Firelight flickers across her face.

Her eyes remain locked
on the mysterious figure.

Recognition slowly settles into her expression.

Do not exaggerate her emotion.

She is tense,
controlled,
and stunned by what she is seeing.


After a short silence,

Riven quietly says:

"You..."


Deliver the line softly.

Low voice.

Almost under her breath.

Not shouted.

Not angry screaming.

It is a simple reaction of recognition.


CUT toward the mysterious figure.

The figure remains silent.

It does not approach.

It does not attack.


After a brief still moment,

the figure makes one very small movement.

Its head or upper body
slowly shifts toward Riven.

Keep this movement extremely subtle.

The movement should suggest
that the figure has recognized her too.


Return to Riven.

She watches it.

Then her hand slowly reaches
toward the Broken Sword.


Riven draws the weapon.


=== BROKEN SWORD CONTINUITY ===

The weapon is ONLY the remaining
HANDLE-SIDE HALF of the original sword.

The upper half is completely missing.

Do not restore the sword.

Do not create a complete blade.

Do not create a pointed tip.

Do not extend the broken blade.

The sword ends at the same large fractured edge
shown in the provided reference.


Riven grips the Broken Sword firmly.

She slowly raises it
into a controlled defensive stance.

She is ready to protect herself,
but she does NOT attack.


The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No glowing runes.

No magical energy.

No reconstructed blade.


Transition into a wider composition.

Establish both sides of the confrontation.

Riven stands at one end
of the smoke-filled road.

The mysterious figure stands farther ahead.

Burning buildings line both sides.

Smoke moves between them.

Neither moves forward.

Neither attacks.


Hold the tension.

For a moment,
it feels as though the confrontation
is about to begin.


Then suddenly—


=== SHOT 3 — HELP ===

From a burning wooden building
NEAR RIVEN and OFF TO ONE SIDE of the main road,

an elderly male voice desperately calls:

"Help! Please!"


The voice does NOT come
from the direction of the mysterious figure.


Riven immediately reacts.

She turns her head sharply toward the voice.

Her defensive stance loosens slightly
as her attention shifts.


Camera follows her gaze.


Through a damaged doorway
or large broken opening
in the nearby burning building,

an ELDERLY MAN is visible inside.


He is an ordinary elderly civilian.

Gray hair.

Simple worn village clothing.

No armor.

No weapon.


Part of the wooden interior has collapsed.

A heavy fallen wooden beam
and debris block his path to the exit.

He cannot free himself.

He cannot escape without help.

Keep the situation visually simple
and immediately understandable.

Do not show graphic injuries.

Do not make the elderly man overly theatrical.

Smoke is gradually filling the interior.


The elderly man sees Riven.

He reaches toward the opening,
but remains trapped.


CUT BACK TO RIVEN.


She still holds the Broken Sword.

She looks toward the trapped elderly man.

For a brief moment,
her attention remains completely on him.


Then—

Riven slowly turns her eyes
back toward the main road.


CUT to Riven's perspective.


The MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE
IS STILL THERE.


It remains standing
in exactly the same general area
farther down the road.

It has NOT disappeared.

It has NOT approached.

It has NOT attacked.


Smoke and orange firelight
continue moving around its dark silhouette.


CUT BACK TO RIVEN.


She looks between the two directions:

the mysterious figure farther down the road,

and the trapped elderly man
inside the nearby burning building.


Riven does NOT make the choice yet.

She does NOT attack the figure.

She does NOT run toward the figure.

She does NOT rescue the elderly man yet.


Hold briefly on Riven.

The broken sword remains in her hand.

The mysterious figure waits ahead.

The elderly man's situation is becoming urgent.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has encountered the mysterious dark figure
face to face.

She recognized it and quietly said:

"You..."

The figure subtly appeared to recognize her too.

Riven has drawn only the remaining handle-side half
of her Broken Sword.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

No combat has started.

An elderly civilian is trapped
inside a nearby burning building.

Riven has seen him.

The mysterious figure remains present
farther down the main road.

Riven has not made her choice yet.

CUT.

=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use the provided Riven's Broken Sword reference for the weapon.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the current environment.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
only for the dark figure.

Maintain the same burning settlement atmosphere:
wooden buildings on fire,
heavy dark smoke,
orange firelight,
ash drifting through the air,
and the long village road running between the buildings.

Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of her Broken Sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The remaining sword is large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured edge with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Burning mountain settlement at nightfall.

Heavy drifting smoke.

Strong orange firelight.

Natural fire, wind, ash, footsteps,
burning wood, and distant structural sounds.

Restrained realistic acting.

Slow controlled cinematic tension.

Natural body movement.

Natural English voice and lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat in this scene.

Keep the geography simple and visually readable.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== IMPORTANT STORY RULE ===

The mysterious figure appears farther down
the main road inside the burning settlement.

Riven and the figure remain separated
by a clear physical distance.

The figure does NOT rush toward Riven.

The figure does NOT attack.

Riven does NOT attack.

This is a tense face-to-face confrontation,
not a fight.

Unlike before,
the mysterious figure does NOT disappear.

It remains present through the end of the scene.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven stands inside the burning settlement,
looking down the long road ahead.

She hears a faint unnatural sound.

Through the smoke farther down the road,
the same mysterious dark figure slowly appears.

This time it is closer and more visible.

It does not disappear.

Riven recognizes it.

Quietly, almost to herself, she says:

"You..."

The figure subtly reacts,
as if it recognizes Riven too.

Riven slowly draws her Broken Sword
and raises the broken weapon defensively.

Before either side attacks,
an elderly man's desperate cry for help
comes from a nearby burning building.

Riven looks toward the voice.

An elderly civilian is trapped inside
and cannot escape by himself.

Riven looks back toward the mysterious figure.

It is still there.

CUT before Riven makes her choice.


=== SHOT 1 — THE ROAD ===

OPEN on a new medium three-quarter view of Riven.

Do not recreate the exact previous camera composition.

Riven is already standing inside
the burning settlement.

She is no longer walking.

Orange firelight flickers naturally
across her face and clothing.

Burning wooden buildings surround the road.

Heavy smoke drifts between the structures.

Ash floats through the orange light.

Riven remains silent.

She looks toward the long road
leading deeper into the settlement.


Then—

a faint unnatural sound comes
from somewhere farther ahead.

Riven immediately becomes alert.

She stops completely.

Her eyes focus on the road.


CUT to an over-the-shoulder view behind Riven.

Use the long central village road
as the main visual axis.

Riven occupies the near foreground.

The road extends deep into the settlement
between burning buildings.

At first there is nothing ahead.

Only fire.

Smoke.

Ash.

An empty road.


Then—

smoke farther down the road
slowly begins to shift.

Through the smoke,

a DARK HUMAN-LIKE SILHOUETTE
gradually becomes visible.


It is the same mysterious dark figure.

Keep it at a clear distance from Riven.

It stands farther down the road.

Do not place it close to her.


The figure is almost humanoid,
but subtly unnatural.

Its shoulders appear slightly too high.

Its arms appear slightly too long.

Its silhouette is difficult to read.

Its edges seem to blend unnaturally
into the surrounding smoke.

Nearby orange firelight does not illuminate it normally.

Its face remains hidden.

No glowing eyes.

No clear facial features.

No detailed monster anatomy.


Smoke continues moving around the figure.

But the figure remains standing there.

THIS TIME IT DOES NOT DISAPPEAR.


Riven remains completely still.

She recognizes it.


=== SHOT 2 — FACE TO FACE ===

Move into a restrained medium close-up of Riven.

Firelight flickers across her face.

Her eyes remain locked
on the mysterious figure.

Recognition slowly settles into her expression.

Do not exaggerate her emotion.

She is tense,
controlled,
and stunned by what she is seeing.


After a short silence,

Riven quietly says:

"You..."


Deliver the line softly.

Low voice.

Almost under her breath.

Not shouted.

Not angry screaming.

It is a simple reaction of recognition.


CUT toward the mysterious figure.

The figure remains silent.

It does not approach.

It does not attack.


After a brief still moment,

the figure makes one very small movement.

Its head or upper body
slowly shifts toward Riven.

Keep this movement extremely subtle.

The movement should suggest
that the figure has recognized her too.


Return to Riven.

She watches it.

Then her hand slowly reaches
toward the Broken Sword.


Riven draws the weapon.


=== BROKEN SWORD CONTINUITY ===

The weapon is ONLY the remaining
HANDLE-SIDE HALF of the original sword.

The upper half is completely missing.

Do not restore the sword.

Do not create a complete blade.

Do not create a pointed tip.

Do not extend the broken blade.

The sword ends at the same large fractured edge
shown in the provided reference.


Riven grips the Broken Sword firmly.

She slowly raises it
into a controlled defensive stance.

She is ready to protect herself,
but she does NOT attack.


The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No glowing runes.

No magical energy.

No reconstructed blade.


Transition into a wider composition.

Establish both sides of the confrontation.

Riven stands at one end
of the smoke-filled road.

The mysterious figure stands farther ahead.

Burning buildings line both sides.

Smoke moves between them.

Neither moves forward.

Neither attacks.


Hold the tension.

For a moment,
it feels as though the confrontation
is about to begin.


Then suddenly—


=== SHOT 3 — HELP ===

From a burning wooden building
NEAR RIVEN and OFF TO ONE SIDE of the main road,

an elderly male voice desperately calls:

"Help! Please!"


The voice does NOT come
from the direction of the mysterious figure.


Riven immediately reacts.

She turns her head sharply toward the voice.

Her defensive stance loosens slightly
as her attention shifts.


Camera follows her gaze.


Through a damaged doorway
or large broken opening
in the nearby burning building,

an ELDERLY MAN is visible inside.


He is an ordinary elderly civilian.

Gray hair.

Simple worn village clothing.

No armor.

No weapon.


Part of the wooden interior has collapsed.

A heavy fallen wooden beam
and debris block his path to the exit.

He cannot free himself.

He cannot escape without help.

Keep the situation visually simple
and immediately understandable.

Do not show graphic injuries.

Do not make the elderly man overly theatrical.

Smoke is gradually filling the interior.


The elderly man sees Riven.

He reaches toward the opening,
but remains trapped.


CUT BACK TO RIVEN.


She still holds the Broken Sword.

She looks toward the trapped elderly man.

For a brief moment,
her attention remains completely on him.


Then—

Riven slowly turns her eyes
back toward the main road.


CUT to Riven's perspective.


The MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE
IS STILL THERE.


It remains standing
in exactly the same general area
farther down the road.

It has NOT disappeared.

It has NOT approached.

It has NOT attacked.


Smoke and orange firelight
continue moving around its dark silhouette.


CUT BACK TO RIVEN.


She looks between the two directions:

the mysterious figure farther down the road,

and the trapped elderly man
inside the nearby burning building.


Riven does NOT make the choice yet.

She does NOT attack the figure.

She does NOT run toward the figure.

She does NOT rescue the elderly man yet.


Hold briefly on Riven.

The broken sword remains in her hand.

The mysterious figure waits ahead.

The elderly man's situation is becoming urgent.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has encountered the mysterious dark figure
face to face.

She recognized it and quietly said:

"You..."

The figure subtly appeared to recognize her too.

Riven has drawn only the remaining handle-side half
of her Broken Sword.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

No combat has started.

An elderly civilian is trapped
inside a nearby burning building.

Riven has seen him.

The mysterious figure remains present
farther down the main road.

Riven has not made her choice yet.
